q: How many woodlice were on the damp side at 6 minutes?
Identify the stimulus and the response.
Stimulus: moisture (damp air). Response: moving to the damp side.
Explain how this behaviour helps woodlice survive.
Woodlice lose water easily through their body covering; staying in damp places stops them drying out.
Suggest two improvements to make the results more reliable.
Use more woodlice, repeat with the sides swapped, keep light and temperature the same on both sides.
